```sql
WITH omaha_region AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM regions
  WHERE region_name ILIKE 'Omaha' AND border_type = 'city'
),
omaha_roads AS (
  SELECT r.id, r.geometry
  FROM roads r
  JOIN omaha_region o
    ON ST_Intersects(r.geometry, o.geometry)
  WHERE r.highway IS NOT NULL
),
longest_road_in_omaha AS (
  SELECT id, geometry
  FROM omaha_roads
  ORDER BY ST_Length(geometry) DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
raster_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    lr.id,
    ST_Length(lr.geometry) AS length_meters,
    ST_DumpAsPolygons(
      ST_Slope(
        ST_Clip(
          public.dem_us.rast,
          true,
          lr.geometry::geometry
        ),
        1
      )
    ) AS slope_dump
  FROM longest_road_in_omaha lr
  CROSS JOIN public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, lr.geometry::geometry)
)
SELECT
  lr.id,
  lr.length_meters,
  MAX(s.slope) AS max_slope_degrees
FROM raster_analysis ra
CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_DumpAsPolygons(ra.slope_dump) AS s(polygon, slope)
JOIN longest_road_in_omaha lr ON ra.id = lr.id
GROUP BY lr.id, lr.length_meters
ORDER BY lr.length_meters DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
